versions.changelog:
- Minimum Aliyun CLI version requirement raised to 3.3.3.
- Updated installation instructions: added direct upgrade command and clarified plugin update steps.
- Enforced the use of a standardized CLI User-Agent (`AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-yike-storyboard`) for all aliyun CLI commands.
- Documentation updates across setup and workflow to reflect new CLI requirements.
- Minor clarifications and corrections in setup, parameter confirmation, and workflow descriptions.

Yike Storyboard Creation Skill – Initial Release

- Introduces an end-to-end AI video creation workflow from novel/script to storyboard via conversational interface.
- Guides users through prerequisites: Aliyun CLI, ICE plugin, service activation, RAM permissions, and login to yikeai platform.
- Provides detailed steps for credential verification and parameter confirmation before file upload.
- Includes text type classification (novel vs script) and workflow customization based on genre, narrative style, and user preferences.
- Outlines the core workflow: parameter confirmation, file upload, storyboard job submission, and job status querying.
- Offers troubleshooting and permission error handling tips with instructional references.
